missing_watched_entity.title: Watched entity for "{title}" is missing
missing_watched_entity.description: The task "{title}" watches `{entity_id}`, but that entity no longer exists. The task's counter or runtime progress will not advance until the entity returns or the task is updated to watch a different entity.

missing_notify_service.title: Notify service for "{title}" is missing
missing_notify_service.description: The task "{title}" sends notifications via `{service}`, but that service is not available. Notifications for this task will fail until the service returns or the task is updated to use a different notify service.
